statement: let T := fun (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t); ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → intervalIntegral (fun t => if (m:ℝ)/2 < T m t then (1:ℝ) else 0) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤ Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)/8)

plain_statement.zh: 超过一半高度的频率集合的显式面积界
plain_statement.en: Explicit area bound above half the packet height

brief.zh: 对实部的单侧尾取指数参数 1/2，证明 cosh(s)≤exp(s²/2)。这个阈值用于实际截断。
brief.en: Apply exponential Markov with s=1/2 and prove cosh(s)≤exp(s²/2). The real one-sided threshold is the one used by the capped packet.
